ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of a plant cell with letter labels. On the right side there is a relatively large purple oval/region, representing the nucleus; inside this purple region there is a small yellow circular structure. Among the labeling arrows, the arrow of F points to this small yellow circular structure, while the arrow of M points to the larger purple nucleus region. Reasoning: The nucleolus is usually a small circular structure located inside the nucleus. The small yellow circular structure located inside the nucleus in the figure is indicated by label F, so the region corresponding to the nucleolus is F.
